title: 5/21-27 scheduler OOM kill during inline shadow prediction (indicated), plus memory-growth thresholds mixing baselines and restart_spike advice assuming a heartbeat gap
missing_evidence: bts-scheduler journal lines (B1 journal_*_retained.txt) around 2026-05-21 13:50-14:00 ET showing 'Main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL' / "Failed with result 'oom-kill'" during an inline shadow run, and the restart that followed
the 5/21-5/23 health state or health DM showing which alerts fired (restart_spike wording, analytics_artifacts_missing) - health_state is latest-state (likely overwritten); DM history is O1
tier_reason: an OOM kill of the production scheduler would be a liveness failure (A) but is not evidenced by any located artifact; the memory-threshold and restart_spike-wording parts on their own are alert-quality issues (B)

contract.text: Research work (the shadow prediction) cannot take down the production scheduler, an OOM/kill is surfaced with its cause, memory alerts compare like with like (post-prediction baseline), and restart alerts point to the evidence rather than a presumed cause.

mechanism.text: the shadow prediction ran inside the scheduler process after the production lock, adding its model memory to the scheduler's multi-GB resident set, so an out-of-memory kill of the shadow run killed the production daemon
OOM evidence from a killed unit was not escalated: missing shadow/capture artifacts stayed WARN and no policy promoted fatal OOM evidence to CRITICAL
memory_growth used absolute thresholds that mixed the ~140 MB sleeping baseline with the normal 2.8-3.6 GB post-prediction RSS
restart_spike's CRITICAL message asserted 'heartbeat-gap regression suspected', steering the operator away from OOM/watchdog/crash causes

verified_recovered.how: 5/27 check: live RSS ~2481.5 MB vs post-prediction baseline median ~3023.7 MB correctly produced no alert

residual.text: Out-of-process shadow was opt-in (shadow_model_unit) and required a hand-installed unit plus a config change on the box; the example config shipped shadow_model = false. When the box switched is not recorded here.

watchdog.trigger: any bts-scheduler exit with Result=oom-kill or code=killed/signal 9 in the journal, or an NRestarts increase with no deploy, reported with the journal cause
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the scheduler is active with NRestarts flat through the next shadow run, and the shadow run's own unit finishes (success or its own OOM) without touching the scheduler

evidence.what: fixtures model bts-scheduler.service 'Main process exited, code=killed, status=9/KILL' and "Failed with result 'oom-kill'" with a shadow dispatch at 2026-05-21T13:53:36-04:00 - consistent with a real event, but a test fixture is not a record

5/23: restart_spike wording 'too narrow when OOM is also a likely cause'; OOM evidence promotion is the right CRITICAL path; memory_growth absolute thresholds mix cold and post-prediction baselines; 5/27: recalibrated memory_growth correctly silent

evidence.locator: PR branch names in merges 67543ca (codex/shadow-capture-serialization, PR #104), a1dea18 (codex/alert-shadow-oom-visibility, PR #105), d550bed (PR #114), cf97035 (PR #136)
